name: StatePreparation of 4 amplitudes
task_prompt: Use Qiskit StatePreparation to prepare amplitudes proportional to [1, 1j, -1, (-0-1j)]. Normalize the target explicitly, obtain the exact Statevector, align global phase before displaying the maximum amplitude error, and assert fidelity greater than 1-1e-12. Also print the nonzero basis probabilities using a clearly stated Qiskit bit-order convention. Output code only as a self-contained Python program. Use documented public APIs, require no cloud credentials, make stochastic behavior reproducible, and include executable checks with justified tolerances.
